item.firesenderexpansion.endchiridion.de: An Enderman's guide to travel and adapting oneself to foreign conditions

item.firesenderexpansion.crystal_heart.d: Allows premature casting of Hollow Crystal by sneak-casting

spell.firesenderexpansion.arcane_slice.g: Selectively teleport a part of a something's body. Deals more damage the less mana they have.

spell.firesenderexpansion.displacement_c: Create a circular portal, teleporting any living thing that tries to leave it back inside

Summon a large quantity of unstable swords and launch them at your enemies with devastating force. Look directly at an entity for targeted mode, or elsewhere for general mode.

spell.firesenderexpansion.hollow_crystal: Manifest an impossibility of Ender magic and send it outwards, moving through blocks and devastating anything in its path.
spell.firesenderexpansion.dragons_fury.g: Strike with the fury of the Ender Dragon, dealing wide but low damage and knocking things away.
spell.firesenderexpansion.scintillating_: Launch forward once, then trigger again to teleport to your previous location and leave behind a burst of damage

death.attack.firesenderexpansion.binary_: %1$s was scattered among the stars by %2$s
spell.firesenderexpansion.ends_rejuvenat: Manifest a number of End Crystal summons that will heal you for 1/2 a heart every second each. They can be damaged and destroyed by enemies.
Manifest a small vacuum in the world, drawing everyone nearby into an existence where all is void. The space will collapse shortly after existing, but while active you will also gain significant strength.
effect.firesenderexpansion.aspect_of_the: Magical damage additionally spawns a homing shulker bullet, on a small cooldown
effect.firesenderexpansion.infinite_void: Handles transportation to and from the void dimension. Should not be messed with.
effect.firesenderexpansion.hollow_crysta: Builds up magical energy for the Hollow Crystal spell. Should not be messed with.
effect.firesenderexpansion.ascended_cast: Designates the caster of a domain and bestows creative flight among other spellcasting related buffs
effect.firesenderexpansion.nova_burn_eff: Causes the affected to take damage when casting spells. This damage scales with the number of positive effects the affected has.
effect.firesenderexpansion.eclipsed_effe: Lessens the affected's attack damage and attack speed. This debuff scales with the number of positive effects the affected has.
effect.firesenderexpansion.striding_effe: When this effect is cleared, it teleports the affected back to where they were when it was applied.
effect.firesenderexpansion.locked_camera: Locks the affected's camera in place, preventing them from turning.
effect.firesenderexpansion.voidtorn_effe: Lowers the mana regeneration and armor of the affected.

advancements.firesenderexpansion.wear_en: Wear the full End Lord armor set
